objective: Implement deterministic regime-aware event studies with exact pre/post windows, descriptive response and uncertainty, and P12-A EVENT_CONTEXT evidence without causal or trade authority.
scope: Aggregate repeated historical event instances with exact pre/post windows
Compute deterministic signed basis-point response per event instance
Compute deterministic mean response and dispersion/sampling uncertainty
Require unique event-instance identities and event timestamps
Require strict pre-event < event < post-event ordering and governed window sizes
Emit P12-A EVENT_CONTEXT / UNATTRIBUTED graph evidence
Preserve provenance SHA-256 and source dataset versions
Support MACRO_EVENT, NEWS_EVENT, CAPITAL_FLOW and ROTATION_EPISODE contexts
out_of_scope: Signal probability, risk approval and execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: active task none, active lock none, open PR none
tests: Known positive event fixture produces deterministic positive mean response
Known negative event fixture produces deterministic negative mean response
Exact pre/post event windows are enforced
Duplicate event identity and duplicate event timestamp fail closed
Minimum qualifying event count fails closed
Zero pre-value and out-of-bound response fail closed
Regime conditioning is deterministic and order-independent
Event node kind and target node kind are governed
Graph edge remains EVENT_CONTEXT and UNATTRIBUTED
Event proximity/historical response is never labelled causal authority
P12-D evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P12-D policy/module/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P12-C remains canonical.
definition_of_done: Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
